description: This file defines the StreamWrapper class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, which converts Guzzle streams into PHP stream resources. It provides methods to register a custom stream wrapper, open streams, read, write, seek, and retrieve stream statistics.

classes.name: StreamWrapper
classes.description: A final class that implements a PHP stream wrapper around Guzzle streams, allowing Guzzle streams to be used as native PHP stream resources.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Creates and returns a PHP stream resource from a Guzzle stream, registering the stream wrapper if necessary.

methods.name: createStreamContext
methods.description: Creates a PHP stream context including the Guzzle stream.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the 'guzzle' stream wrapper if it is not already registered.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream and attaches the Guzzle stream to the PHP resource.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the Guzzle stream.

methods.name: stream_write
methods.description: Writes data to the Guzzle stream.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the Guzzle stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached EOF.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the Guzzle stream.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Returns a PHP stream resource from the Guzzle stream.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns an array of stream statistics.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Returns an array of URL statistics for a given stream.
